charts.empty.column: This chart needs a column the data does not have.
charts.empty.tooMany: Too many combinations to chart: pick fewer groups.
charts.empty.noRows: No rows inside under the current filters and time.
charts.click.match: Showing {name}: the match filter applies in the team view.
charts.click.time: The time window shows that slice. Set the timeline back to All to see everything.
charts.click.on: Showing only {name}. Click it again to show everything.
charts.btn.label: Charts for {name}
charts.btn.title: Charts for {name}: add a chart of the rows inside this volume, or edit its charts
charts.sign.dragTitle: Drag to move the chart. A fixed board moves over the ground; Shift+drag moves it up and down.
charts.sign.collapse: Fold the chart to its title
charts.sign.tableTitle: Show the values as a table
charts.sign.sendTitle: Send this chart to an analysis document (without one open, it is copied)
charts.sign.sampledTitle: Part of this chart is counted from an even sample of the rows, each standing for the rows it skips. The rows are kept exactly up to the memory the tab can spare; past it the rows outside the volumes are thinned first, then the rows inside.
charts.kind.barHint: Counts or rates per group: team, class, weapon, player, event type
charts.kind.stackedHint: Each group's rows split by a second dimension
charts.kind.lineHint: A measure over time: match time or the data's clock
charts.kind.areaHint: A measure over time, its area shaded
charts.kind.histogramHint: How a numeric column is spread: distances, speeds, heights, damage
charts.kind.pieHint: Parts of a whole, for two to five parts only
charts.kind.tilesHint: The numbers inside: rows, rate, share, players, kills per death, a median
charts.kind.matrixHint: Rows of one dimension against another, e.g. weapon by team
charts.kind.scatterHint: Two numeric columns against each other, as density
charts.field.title: Title
charts.field.upToNowTitle: In playback, count everything up to the playhead, whatever the time window
charts.sort.label: By name
charts.mode.billboardTitle: Faces the screen and keeps its size, hanging beside the volume
charts.mode.fixedTitle: Stands in the world at a heading, sized against the volume
charts.mode.faceTitle: Turn the board so it faces the camera
charts.send.copied: No document is open: the chart was copied as a block to paste.
charts.send.failed: The chart could not be copied.
charts.panel.title: Charts: {name}
charts.panel.addTitle: Add a chart of the rows inside this volume; it stands beside the volume
charts.panel.duplicateTitle: Add a copy of this chart
charts.vol.title: Charts
charts.vol.none: No charts on this volume yet. Add one: it stands beside the volume in the world.
charts.vol.addTitle: Add a chart of the rows inside the selected volume
charts.vol.show: Show the charts in the world
charts.doc.exprTitle: Count with a Compare expression: a statistic such as count() or avg(speed), grouped and filtered by expressions
charts.doc.moduleTitle: Count with the chart settings a volume's sign uses: measure, group, compare, filters
charts.doc.rowsSaved: The rows it was sent with (its filters and time window)
charts.doc.volumeGone: Its volume is gone: counted over the data instead.
